legend.title: Unit tokens
legend.ship: A ship sticks out of its circle. The badge at the top left means it takes a fleet pool slot.
legend.fighter: A fighter has no badge: it takes no fleet pool slot.
legend.ground: Infantry and mechs stand in triangles.
legend.structure: PDS and space docks stand in squares.

sheet.title: Tile {{number}}
sheet.unknown: This tile number is not in the game data.

builder.title: Set the tile
builder.unknown: No tile "{{query}}" in the game data.
builder.ambiguous: "{{query}}" has two sides: pick one, for example {{query}}A.
builder.duplicates: Tile placed more than once: {{list}}. This is allowed.

plan.noGame: Start or open a game first.
plan.name: Plan name

cards.hint: Tap once for backup, again for main, again to clear. The card is played in the action phase.
cards.hintTwo: With 3 or 4 players two cards are held. Tap once for the second card, again for main, again to clear. Cards are played in the action phase.

menu.secondary: Secondary ability, any number of times

entries.label: Label
entries.planetsRefresh: Planets refresh at the start of the next round.

tactical.title: Tactical action
tactical.pickHint: Tap the system to activate: it spends a tactic token.
tactical.sourceHint: Tap the system the ships come from.
tactical.moveHint: Drag from a tile with ships to the active system, or back.
tactical.noDock: No space dock in this system.
tactical.freeToken: Warfare: no tactic token is spent, the command token still goes in the system.
tactical.freePickHint: Tap the system for the Warfare tactical action: no tactic token is spent.

picker.title: From {{from}} to {{to}}
picker.empty: None of your units are here.

warning.shortResources: Not enough resources: need {{needed}}, paid {{paid}}, short by {{short}}.
warning.shortInfluence: Not enough influence: need {{needed}}, paid {{paid}}, short by {{short}}.
warning.shortTradeGoods: Not enough trade goods: need {{needed}}, have {{have}}.
warning.capacityGroup: Group from {{from}} is over capacity: {{load}} of {{capacity}}.
warning.fleetPool: System {{system}} is over the fleet pool: {{ships}} ships, {{fleet}} tokens.
warning.primaryRepeated: The primary has already been played this round: cards held {{held}}.

phases.actionEmpty: Tactical actions, abilities, passing and manual adjustments.
phases.statusEmpty: New tokens and every player's points for the round.
phases.agendaEmpty: A vote, if Mecatol Rex is held. No entries here yet.

strategy.locked: A choice has been made. To change the card or the mode, cancel the action.
strategy.forTokenNote: Costs 1 strategy token. For faction abilities, such as Jol-Nar's Brilliant on Technology.
strategy.mapHint: Tap a tile on the map.
strategy.systemPrimary: Choose a system with your planet
strategy.speaker: The speaker passes to
strategy.politicsPrimary: +2 action cards, 2 agendas to the top or bottom of the deck.
strategy.dock: Production in a space dock, the Thunder's Edge primary
strategy.free: Who uses the secondary for free
strategy.freeTactical: Start a tactical action without a token
strategy.freeTacticalNote: Opens the usual flight. Tokens can be rearranged before and after.
strategy.shopNote: Opens the shop on the big hex.
strategy.noHome: The home system is not on the map.
strategy.techPrimary: The first is free, the second costs 6 resources. Cost now: {{n}}. The app does not track other technologies.
strategy.techSecondary: Costs 4 resources per technology. Now: {{n}}. The app does not track other technologies.
strategy.imperialNote: Otherwise draw a secret objective. A public objective is marked in the status phase.

expedition.title: Expedition
expedition.hint: A tap marks a part as taken by another player. You play your own part as a plan entry, at the end of your turn.
expedition.complete: All six parts are taken. Choose a system for Thunder's Edge.
expedition.placeHint: Tap a highlighted system to place Thunder's Edge.

fracture.title: Fracture
fracture.markHint: Tap systems to add or remove ingress tokens.
fracture.note: Not an action: the Fracture comes in with a die roll on gaining a breakthrough, or from an effect.

mapImport.title: Paste map
mapImport.placeholder: Paste the map string from Milty Draft
mapImport.confirm: The map already has tiles. Replace them?
mapImport.mismatch: Expected {{expected}} tiles outside the home systems, found {{found}}.
mapImport.homesEmpty: Home systems stay empty: place them by seat.
mapImport.dropped: Skipped {{n}} tiles that have no slot in this layout.
mapImport.tokens: String has {{n}} tokens, Milty writes 60. A leading 18 or a missing token shifts every tile.
mapImport.offExpansion: Tiles {{list}} belong to {{name}}, which is off in this game.
mapImport.set: This list holds {{n}} tiles and no positions. Home systems go to the seats in seat order, other tiles fill the free slots in ring order, Mecatol Rex stays in the centre.

layout.label: Map layout
layout.needsPok: Hyperlane tiles come with Prophecy of Kings.
layout.confirm_one: The map has {{count}} tile that this layout removes (in slots it lacks or under hyperlanes). Switch?
layout.confirm_other: The map has {{count}} tiles that this layout removes (in slots it lacks or under hyperlanes). Switch?
layout.milty: Hyperlane layout as in Milty Draft: {{n}} hyperlane slots, more than the 9 hyperlane tiles in the box.

players.title: Players
players.seatsNote: Every player has a number. Move the numbers on the map: on a taken seat the players swap. You can also tap one number, then another. Player 1 is your faction, marked with a white ring.
players.confirm: Tiles on the map: {{filled}}, of them leaving: {{lost}}. The map moves to the new template and matching slots stay. Change the player count?
players.confirmHoldings: Units on the map: {{units}}, planets: {{planets}}. The units, docks and PDS go, and the planets become free.

stage.battleNote: Tap a token to record a loss. Tap a picture here to give the unit back.
stage.buildNote: Tap a token with a gold ring to take a purchase back.
stage.setupNote: Tap a token on the hex to remove one.
stage.planetNote: Tap a planet: ground units and structures go there.
